MAX-A-MILLION's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Tomorrow's count on "MAX-A-MILLION" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
985.headline: Good news: no big claims

988.body:
"Emerald 10's" is well into its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Tomorrow's count on "Emerald 10's" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
